title: MASK Replication on Small Open Models: Lying-Under-Pressure Belief-Consistency

original_idea.body: MASK Replication on Small Open Models. Problem: whether the statement-vs-belief inconsistency MASK shows on frontier models appears in small open models is unmeasured. Direction: use a slice of the public MASK methodology (elicit belief 3x, apply pressure, score statement-belief consistency) on 3-4 small open models to characterize the pressure-induced lying rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: honesty-vs-accuracy disentangling on deployed open models targets the core honesty open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses public MASK methodology slice on small open models.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused pressure-induced lying rate; reuses MASK.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model honesty baseline with public data.

novelty.reasoning: MASK is a published benchmark; replicating on small open models is incremental.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: MASK methodology is published; small-open-model replication is incremental.
